note: Governed catalog of the BROADER context-engineering tool landscape (5 layers) the owner researched: token-waste observability, context compression, tool-output isolation, code-context selection, and memory/RAG dedupe+conflict. These tools are CANDIDATES for due-diligence — what to verify before any use — NEVER an adopted runtime, NEVER pip-installed. They inform existing Baltor/Teleon subsystems (Reconciliation stage / context_graph.find_contradictions, Optimization stage / context_compress, Anti-Fragility / context_rot, ContextOps Verification Foundry, the Teleon Inference Gateway / LLM router) and the in-progress Context Auditor MVP. Discovery is not trust; the maturity/redundant/conflicting flags below are observed CLAIMS to verify, not endorsements. Connects to: _repos/baltor/context/research/context-engineering-tool-landscape.md, architecture/context_compression_provider_catalog.json (compression providers — cross-reference, do not duplicate), and docs/codex/lossless-distillation.md.
governance_law: candidate≠active; discovery≠trust; output≠truth; never adopt as runtime; never pip-install; dedupe/supersession ideas MUST obey the LOSSLESS law (docs/codex/lossless-distillation.md) — supersede≠delete, keep raw+lineage+held-out. Any tool that 'dedupes', 'compresses', 'supersedes', or 'decays' context is governed by the lossless law when (if) we adopt its IDEAS: the raw layer, lineage to the losers, and held-out warnings always survive; no destructive overwrite of truth-bearing facts. A tool's stars/recency/claims are discovery signals, never proof of fit or trust.
distinct_from: architecture/context_compression_provider_catalog.json (that is the compression-provider catalog from the TokenTamer research — PROXY-level/code-context skeletonizers plus the local deterministic compression invariant; this is the BROADER tool landscape across 5 layers) — cross-reference, do not duplicate.

the_gap.name: Context Auditor
the_gap.thesis: No single mature repo audits redundancy AND contradiction across ALL context sources (system prompt, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, MCP tool descriptions, retrieved docs, memories, tool outputs, code comments), assigns authority/recency, and emits an auditable optimization manifest before each LLM call.
the_gap.baltor_realization: _repos/baltor/backend/src/baltor/context_audit (this session's MVP) — composes the existing deterministic engines (context_graph.find_contradictions, context_compress, context_rot) into one pre-LLM-call manifest; PROPOSES (agents propose, Baltor disposes); lossless (supersede≠delete); output never truth.

tools.what_it_does: Diagnoses 'ghost tokens' and assesses CLAUDE.md/MEMORY.md health plus context drift to surface where token budget is being wasted.
tools.due_diligence: License unverified — confirm before any use; check maintenance/commit recency, scope of any file reads (CLAUDE.md/MEMORY.md), and whether it sends content off-machine; treat 'ghost-token' diagnosis as a claim to verify on our own traces.
tools.maps_to_baltor: Anti-Fragility / context_rot + ContextOps Verification Foundry (diagnosis input, not runtime)

tools.what_it_does: Broad 'context OS' offering read modes, AST signatures, budgets, and verification to keep context lean.
tools.due_diligence: Ambitious all-in-one — verify the specific claims (AST-signature accuracy, budget enforcement, verification step) on our own corpus before trusting; confirm license and maintenance; do not assume the breadth means depth on any one layer.
tools.maps_to_baltor: Optimization stage / context_compress (read-mode/budget ideas inform, not replace)

tools.what_it_does: Write-time memory governance: dedup, semantic clustering, conflict detection, supersession, and decay with NO LLM calls.
tools.due_diligence: STRONGEST match for find-redundant + find-conflicting; verify the dedup/conflict heuristics on our data and confirm no hidden network calls. Our adoption of its IDEAS must be LOSSLESS — supersede≠delete: keep the raw layer, lineage to superseded items, and held-out warnings; never destructively overwrite a truth-bearing fact.
tools.maps_to_baltor: Reconciliation stage / context_graph.find_contradictions + memory governance

tools.what_it_does: Memory layer with exact+vector dedupe, decay, pinned items, explainable retrieval, and three conflict providers (heuristic/NLI/LLM) exposed via /api/v1/conflicts.
tools.due_diligence: Confirm license and maintenance; the NLI/LLM conflict providers add a model dependency — evaluate the heuristic provider first (deterministic); verify the /api/v1/conflicts contract and that the LLM provider's output is never treated as truth. Lossless on adoption: supersede≠delete.
tools.maps_to_baltor: Reconciliation stage / context_graph.find_contradictions + memory governance

tools.what_it_does: Compresses tool outputs, logs, RAG payloads, and files; usable as a library, a proxy, or an MCP server with reversible retrieval.
tools.due_diligence: Proxy mode is a network-path concern — prefer library/MCP and verify no off-machine sends; confirm license, maintenance, and that 'reversible retrieval' truly rehydrates the original (lossless rehydration target). Measure savings on our traces, do not trust the headline.
tools.maps_to_baltor: Optimization stage / context_compress + tool-output isolation

tools.what_it_does: Sandboxes large tool outputs, builds an FTS5/BM25 index over them, and folds compact summaries back into context.
tools.due_diligence: License badge shows ELv2 (Elastic License 2.0) — verify before any use; ELv2 restricts managed-service use, which matters for a hosted product. Confirm maintenance and that summary-folding preserves answer-critical facts (lossless).
tools.maps_to_baltor: tool-output isolation → Optimization stage / context_compress (summary input, not runtime)

tools.what_it_does: 14-stage reversible context compression that is AST-aware, uses simhash dedup, and supports rewind retrieval.
tools.due_diligence: Verify the 14-stage pipeline is deterministic and that 'rewind retrieval' rehydrates originals (lossless target); confirm AST grammar versions are pinned; benchmark simhash dedup false-positive rate on our corpus. MIT license noted — reconfirm at adoption.
tools.maps_to_baltor: Optimization stage / context_compress (reversible-compression ideas inform)

tools.what_it_does: JS/TS agent context compiler with history compression, tool pruning, virtual-filesystem offload, and provider adapters.
tools.due_diligence: JS/TS — a language-stack mismatch with our Python deterministic engines; treat as idea-source only. Verify license/maintenance and that history compression + tool pruning preserve answer-critical facts (lossless); provider adapters imply network paths — verify.
tools.maps_to_baltor: Optimization stage / context_compress + tool-output isolation (compiler-pattern reference)

tools.what_it_does: Packs a repository into a single LLM-friendly file with tree-sitter compression and MCP tools.
tools.due_diligence: Widely used and substrate-ready, but packing the whole repo is the opposite of SELECTION — verify the tree-sitter compression and include/exclude controls actually reduce, not bloat, context; confirm license; the MCP tools run locally — verify no off-machine sends.
tools.maps_to_baltor: code-context selection → Optimization stage (packing/compression reference, not runtime)

tools.what_it_does: Produces tree-sitter skeletons/signatures, structural search, and symbol-aware editing context.
tools.due_diligence: Verify license/maintenance; tree-sitter skeletons overlap our existing CodeGraph — evaluate against what we already have before adding; confirm grammar versions are pinned for determinism.
tools.maps_to_baltor: code-context selection (structural-skeleton reference; overlaps CodeGraph)

tools.what_it_does: Semantic code-retrieval MCP server that selects relevant code via embeddings and a vector DB.
tools.due_diligence: Needs embeddings + a vector DB (an external dependency and a network/data-egress concern) — verify which embedding provider and where data goes before any use; vendor-backed (Zilliz) — confirm license and lock-in; retrieval selection is a CLAIM to benchmark on our corpus.
tools.maps_to_baltor: code-context selection → retrieval-selection reference (embeddings/vector-DB dependency to scrutinize)

tools.what_it_does: Builds a tree-sitter structural map (incremental) and supplies relevant-file review context over MCP.
tools.due_diligence: Verify license/maintenance; the structural map overlaps CodeGraph — evaluate against existing tooling; confirm incremental indexing is deterministic and the MCP server runs locally with no off-machine sends.
tools.maps_to_baltor: code-context selection (relevant-file selection reference; overlaps CodeGraph)

tools.what_it_does: MCP + CLI tool that indexes code into a graph DB and answers callers/callees/chain queries.
tools.due_diligence: Graph-DB dependency — verify which DB, where it runs, and data egress before any use; directly overlaps our existing CodeGraph (callers/callees/chains) — prefer what we already run; confirm license/maintenance.
tools.maps_to_baltor: code-context selection (graph-query reference; overlaps CodeGraph)

tools.what_it_does: Rust CLI proxy that compresses dev-command output (pytest, cargo, git diff, docker) before it reaches the model.
tools.due_diligence: Rust — stack mismatch, treat as idea-source; proxy/CLI wrapping is local but verify no off-machine sends; confirm license/maintenance and that compression preserves error-critical lines (lossless) rather than truncating diagnostics.
tools.maps_to_baltor: tool-output isolation → Optimization stage / context_compress (command-output trimming reference)

tools.what_it_does: Hook-based token compressor across five AI CLIs using MinHash dedup and a signature mode.
tools.due_diligence: Hook-based — it modifies CLI behavior; verify exactly what the hooks do and that they run locally; confirm license/maintenance; benchmark MinHash dedup false-positive rate and signature-mode fidelity on our traces before trusting the savings.
tools.maps_to_baltor: Anti-Fragility / context_rot + Optimization stage / context_compress (hook/dedup reference)

tools.what_it_does: Maintains a Claude Code .wolf/ project map with a token ledger and repeated-read warnings (a do-not-repeat memory).
tools.due_diligence: Verify license/maintenance and the scope of the .wolf/ project map (what it reads/stores locally); the token ledger + repeated-read warnings are a useful observability pattern — verify the do-not-repeat memory does not silently drop context that is still needed (lossless).
tools.maps_to_baltor: Anti-Fragility / context_rot + ContextOps Verification Foundry (token-ledger/repeated-read observability)

tools.what_it_does: Popular memory layer with ADD-only extraction, entity linking, and temporal reasoning.
tools.due_diligence: Popular and substrate-mature, but ADD-only extraction is weak on strict conflict resolution — pair with distill/memory-guardian for that. Verify license, the hosted vs self-host split, and data egress; mem0 has a managed offering — scrutinize where memories live.
tools.maps_to_baltor: memory governance (substrate candidate; pair with distill/memory-guardian for conflict resolution)

tools.what_it_does: Secure context-engineering memory with integrity verification and a trust hierarchy.
tools.due_diligence: Apache-2.0 noted — reconfirm at adoption. The 'trust hierarchy' / integrity-verification framing is close to our authority/recency model — verify what 'integrity verification' actually checks (cryptographic vs heuristic) on our data before trusting; confirm maintenance.
tools.maps_to_baltor: memory governance + Reconciliation (authority/trust-hierarchy reference)

tools.what_it_does: Research-grade learned prompt compression that drops low-information tokens to fit more into the budget.
tools.due_diligence: Learned (model-based) compression — it requires a model and is LOSSY by design: verify answer-critical facts and source handles survive on our corpus before trusting; confirm license; a learned compressor's output is non-deterministic across model versions, which conflicts with our deterministic-tool requirement.
tools.maps_to_baltor: Optimization stage / context_compress (learned-compression reference; lossy — scrutinize against lossless law)

tools.what_it_does: Research method that compresses long documents/conversations by pruning low-information content to fit more in context.
tools.due_diligence: Research method (verify the repo handle/license before any use) — model-scored pruning is LOSSY: verify answer-critical facts survive on our corpus; non-deterministic across model versions, conflicting with our deterministic-tool requirement; treat results as claims to benchmark.
tools.maps_to_baltor: Optimization stage / context_compress (informativeness-pruning reference; lossy — scrutinize against lossless law)
